build.what: Deterministic engine (ingest, segment, verify, loop, compare, conformance, metrics, report)
build.evidence: Commits with Refs: T01-T06, T09-T12; docs/AI_USAGE_LOG.md

build.what: Spec extraction: reading the PDF and writing cited contracts

build.who: IBM Bob 2.0 subagents and background tasks
IBM Bob 2.0 (/sp-loop), judged only by the deterministic verifier
Deterministic Python only; no model judges its own output

rules.rule: Contract JSON is valid against the schema
Each quote appears verbatim on its cited page; names appear in their quotes; enum values appear in their citations; samples are verbatim
Required flag and type match the single-line table row
The document's own samples parse as JSON and validate against the extracted contract
Method and path match the deterministic segmenter's hints
Every table row the detector finds is present in the contract

limitations: Validated on one vendor PDF with a regular table layout. Other layouts may need new row detectors.
Prose-only rules (conditional requirements, version notes) are captured as descriptions, not verified semantics.
Client conformance covers Python Pydantic models only.
Hand-audit precision has the confidence interval of the audited sample size; the interval is shown next to the value.
Rows whose cells wrap across lines cannot be row-checked; they are reported as not checked, never as passed.
